metrics.name: order_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN orders.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: 按下单日期统计全部订单，每个订单号一次，包含取消单。

metrics.name: paid_order_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: 状态为 paid 的订单数，包括后来全部退款的订单。

metrics.name: valid_order_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: 状态为 paid 且实付金额减退款金额大于零的订单数；取消和全退不计。

metrics.name: cancelled_order_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'cancelled' then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: 状态为 cancelled 的订单数。

metrics.name: refund_order_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: paid 状态且退款金额大于零的订单数，包括部分退款与全部退款。

metrics.name: partial_refund_order_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 and refund_cents < paid_cents then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: paid 状态且退款大于零、小于实付金额的订单数。

metrics.name: full_refund_order_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents > 0 and refund_cents = paid_cents then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: paid 状态且实付大于零、退款等于实付的订单数。

metrics.name: payment_cents

dialects.expression: SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents else 0 end)

metrics.description: paid 订单实付金额合计，尚未扣退款；按下单日期归属；单位分。

metrics.name: refund_cents

dialects.expression: SUM(case when status = 'paid' then refund_cents else 0 end)

metrics.description: paid 订单退款金额合计，按原订单下单日期归属；单位分。

metrics.name: net_sales_cents

dialects.expression: SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end)

metrics.description: paid 订单实付减退款后合计；取消单不计；按原订单下单日期归属；单位分。

metrics.name: gross_cents

dialects.expression: SUM(case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents else 0 end)

metrics.description: paid 订单折扣前原价金额合计；单位分。

metrics.name: discount_cents

dialects.expression: SUM(case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents - paid_cents else 0 end)

metrics.description: paid 订单原价减实付的金额合计；退款不冲减原优惠金额；单位分。

metrics.name: buyer_count

dialects.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end)

metrics.description: 统计窗口及筛选条件内有有效订单的不同 CRM 会员账户数，不做跨系统自然人去重。

metrics.name: refund_buyer_count

dialects.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then member_id end)

metrics.description: 统计窗口内发生退款的 paid 订单关联的不同 CRM 会员账户数。

metrics.name: selling_store_count

dialects.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then store_id end)

metrics.description: 窗口内至少有一笔有效订单的不同订单归属门店数。

metrics.name: valid_order_items

dialects.expression: SUM(case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then quantity end)

metrics.description: 有效订单中的原始购买件数合计；不是净商品销量。

metrics.name: avg_order_value

dialects.expression: case when SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 then null else SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end) / SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) end

metrics.description: 净销售额除以有效订单数，单位分／单；分母为零时未定义。

metrics.name: avg_buyer_value

dialects.expression: case when COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end) = 0 then null else SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end) / COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end) end

metrics.description: 净销售额除以购买会员数，单位分／账户；分母为零时未定义。

metrics.name: purchase_frequency

dialects.expression: case when COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end) = 0 then null else SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end) end

metrics.description: 有效订单数除以购买会员数，单位单／账户；分母为零时未定义。

metrics.name: refund_amount_rate

dialects.expression: case when SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents else 0 end) = 0 then null else SUM(case when status = 'paid' then refund_cents else 0 end) / SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents else 0 end) end

metrics.description: 退款金额除以实付金额；分母为零时未定义。

metrics.name: cancel_rate

dialects.expression: case when SUM(CASE WHEN orders.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 then null else SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'cancelled' then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN orders.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) end

metrics.description: 取消订单数除以创建订单数；分母为零时未定义。

metrics.name: refund_order_rate

dialects.expression: case when SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 then null else SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) end

metrics.description: 退款订单数除以支付订单数；分母为零时未定义。

metrics.name: discount_rate

dialects.expression: case when SUM(case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents else 0 end) = 0 then null else SUM(case when status = 'paid' then SUM(case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents else 0 end) - paid_cents else 0 end) / SUM(case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents else 0 end) end

metrics.description: 优惠金额除以支付订单原价金额；分母为零时未定义。

metrics.name: items_per_order

dialects.expression: case when SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 then null else SUM(case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then quantity end) / SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) end

metrics.description: 有效订单商品件数除以有效订单数；分母为零时未定义。

metrics.name: new_member_count

dialects.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT members.member_id)

metrics.description: 按注册日期统计新注册 CRM 账户数；不等于自然人数。

metrics.name: first_buyer_count

dialects.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT case when is_first_order then member_id end)

metrics.description: 在测试覆盖期内首次有效订单落入查询窗口的不同 CRM 账户数；先用全覆盖历史确定首次，再按窗口筛选。

metrics.name: first_order_sales_cents

dialects.expression: SUM(case when is_first_order then net_cents else 0 end)

metrics.description: 每个账户在测试覆盖期内第一笔有效订单的净销售额，按该单日期归属，相同日期按订单号排序；单位分。

metrics.name: first_order_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN case when is_first_order then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: 在全测试覆盖期内先为每个账户按日期、订单号排序，其第一笔有效订单落入窗口的单数。

metrics.name: repeat_order_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN case when not is_first_order then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: 账户全测试覆盖期内第二笔及以后的有效订单，按订单日期落入窗口计数；不是月内复购人数。

metrics.name: monthly_buyer_count

dialects.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT case when valid_order_cnt >= 1 then member_id end)

metrics.description: 同一自然月有至少一笔有效订单的账户数，仅整月、全门店口径；不能跨月加总。

metrics.name: monthly_repeat_buyer_count

dialects.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT case when valid_order_cnt >= 2 then member_id end)

metrics.description: 同一自然月有至少两笔有效订单的账户数，仅整月、全门店口径。

metrics.name: monthly_repeat_rate

dialects.expression: case when COUNT(DISTINCT case when valid_order_cnt >= 1 then member_id end) = 0 then null else COUNT(DISTINCT case when valid_order_cnt >= 2 then member_id end) / COUNT(DISTINCT case when valid_order_cnt >= 1 then member_id end) end

metrics.description: 同一自然月的月内复购会员数除以月内购买会员数，仅整月、全门店口径；分母为零时未定义；跨多月查询必须按月展示。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_buyer_count

dialects.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT case when is_paid_eligible and valid_order_cnt >= 1 then member_id end)

metrics.description: 自然月内有至少一笔有效订单、且月末最后一天符合付费资格（悦享年卡、家庭季卡在判定日有效）的不同账户数，按账户去重；仅完整自然月。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_order_count

dialects.expression: SUM(case when is_paid_eligible then valid_order_cnt else 0 end)

metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格的账户在该自然月的全部有效订单数，按账户资格筛选，不按卡重复；仅完整自然月。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_sales_cents

dialects.expression: SUM(case when is_paid_eligible then net_cents else 0 end)

metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格的账户在该自然月的有效订单净销售额合计，单位分；仅完整自然月。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count

dialects.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT case when is_paid_eligible and valid_order_cnt >= 2 then member_id end)

metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格，且同一自然月至少有两笔有效订单的不同账户数；仅完整自然月。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_repeat_rate

dialects.expression: case when COUNT(DISTINCT case when is_paid_eligible and valid_order_cnt >= 1 then member_id end) = 0 then null else COUNT(DISTINCT case when is_paid_eligible and valid_order_cnt >= 2 then member_id end) / COUNT(DISTINCT case when is_paid_eligible and valid_order_cnt >= 1 then member_id end) end

metrics.description: 月末付费会员复购人数除以月末付费会员购买人数；分母为零时未定义；仅完整自然月。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_avg_order_value

dialects.expression: case when SUM(case when is_paid_eligible then valid_order_cnt else 0 end) = 0 then null else SUM(case when is_paid_eligible then net_cents else 0 end) / SUM(case when is_paid_eligible then valid_order_cnt else 0 end) end

metrics.description: 月末付费会员净销售额除以月末付费会员有效订单数，单位分／单；分母零时未定义；仅完整自然月。
